title: The Insane Story Behind James Bond's Aston Martin
description:
In Ian Fleming's novel, James Bond does not drive a DB5. Aston Martin was reluctant to lend its cars. The first script gave the car only a smokescreen. And the film's last pick-up shots were filmed on the day Fleming died. This is the story behind James Bond's Aston Martin, told only from sources we name, with the conflicts between them left in. Our sources are Wikipedia's pages on Goldfinger and on the DB5, Top Gear, the James Bond Dossier, Ecurie, Carole Nash, NBC, CNN, Old Cars Weekly and InsideHook. They disagree in places, and we show both versions. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
